title: View pane (collapsible section)
description: A collapsible section of a side bar view (e.g. Explorer's folder, Outline, Timeline): header with twistie, title and actions, and a body.
usage: Children of <vsc-sidebar>; several panes stack and the expanded ones share the height. Header actions go in slot="actions". Click the header to toggle.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: View icon (shown when the view is moved to the panel)

examples.title: Explorer sections
examples.html: <vsc-sidebar heading="Explorer" style="height: 833px;"><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="toolbar-more" label="Views and More Actions..." dropdown></vsc-action><vsc-pane heading="ws" section="Explorer Section: ws" icon="explorer-view-icon" expanded><vsc-action slot="actions" menu icon="new-file" label="New File..."></vsc-action><vsc-action slot="actions" menu icon="new-folder" label="New Folder..." focusable="false"></vsc-action><vsc-action slot="actions" menu icon="refresh" label="Refresh Explorer" focusable="false"></vsc-action><vsc-action slot="actions" menu icon="collapse-all" label="Collapse Folders in Explorer" focusable="false"></vsc-action><vsc-tree><vsc-tree-item kind="folder" label="src"></vsc-tree-item><vsc-tree-item label="package.json"></vsc-tree-item><vsc-tree-item label="README.md"></vsc-tree-item></vsc-tree></vsc-pane><vsc-pane heading="Outline" icon="outline-view-icon"><vsc-action slot="actions" menu icon="collapse-all" label="Collapse All"></vsc-action><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="toolbar-more" label="More Actions..." dropdown focusable="false"></vsc-action></vsc-pane><vsc-pane heading="Timeline" icon="timeline-view-icon"></vsc-pane></vsc-sidebar>
